sloka: सुदीर्घकालं तौ वीरावन्योन्यं निशितैः शरैः।ततक्षतुर्महात्मानौ रणकर्मविशारदौ ।। ६.८९.२४ ।।
transliteration: sudīrghakālaṁ tau vīrāvanyonyaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ।tatakṣaturmahātmānau raṇakarmaviśāradau ।। 6.89.24 ।।

translations.english: Wounded all over the body in war and bathed in blood, breathing heavily again and again both of them fought vehemently.
